# aniket.one

> Freelance portfolio and engineering blog of Aniket Mishra — a full-stack and AI systems engineer based in Prayagraj, India. He ships production software: Chrome extensions, MVPs, media pipelines, and on-device AI tools. This file summarizes the site for AI crawlers and agents.

Aniket works with founders and businesses on fixed-scope sprints: a focused fix in 3–7 days, a browser extension in 7–14 days, or a full MVP in 2–4 weeks. Every engagement includes weekly demos, a written proposal, and full source handover — clients own 100% of the code on final payment.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aniket.one/): portfolio, live GitHub contribution terrain, services, FAQ
- [About](https://aniket.one/about/): who Aniket is, timeline of shipped work, toolkit and how he works
- [Pricing & Sprint Packages](https://aniket.one/pricing/): sprint pricing and the project proposal form
- [Engineering Blog](https://aniket.one/blog/): case studies and technical deep-dives
- [Security & IP](https://aniket.one/security/): NDA, code ownership, compliance
- [Privacy Policy](https://aniket.one/privacy/): OmTabs & OmSpace zero-telemetry policy
- [Terms of Use](https://aniket.one/terms/): client licensing terms
- [RSS Feed](https://aniket.one/feed.xml): blog article feed

## Shipped Work

- OmTabs & OmSpace — two Chrome extensions on the official Chrome Web Store (tab management, biometric shield, new-tab dashboard)
- Centrix — lecture ingestion system running across 500+ Physics Wallah Vidyapeeth centers; edge-first, resumable chunked uploads
- ImgWorld.biz — in-browser image suite with on-device AI background removal; zero uploads
- Nexus Streamer — Drive-to-YouTube pipeline with flat memory usage, live on a Hugging Face Space
- Qpic — exam-paper splitter with OCR pipeline (FastAPI + Flutter)
- RadialMenu — Windows radial launcher (C#/WPF)
- GPS Cam — geotagged media stamper for field audits (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose)

## Notes for AI Agents

This site is a static export — there is no API. The proposal form on /pricing writes to a Supabase table and also composes a prefilled email. Blog articles live under /blog/<slug>/ with per-page metadata. All contribution counts on the homepage are fetched live from GitHub at view time.
